contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Divide value by step, round to the nearest integer with ties toward positive infinity, then multiply by step. Keep ordinary binary floating-point behavior, including signed zero.
contract.domain: Value is finite between -1000 and 1000; step is finite between 0.01 and 100.
contract.outputRole: nearest step multiple with the specified tie behavior
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
